title: Traffic fines
description: Fines and tolls for your cars, matched to the driver at the time

help.title: About traffic fines
help.overview: Enter a fine when the notice arrives. The booking whose pickup and return cover the time of the offence is found by itself, with its main driver.

sections.title: On this page
items: Charge the customer to add the fine and the handling fee to their booking; a saved card is charged straight away.
Download the driver letter to name the driver to the authority.
If the car or time is corrected, use Match again.
